items.text: Kobeik eroet lokiareit Simeon, ŋes ateker naka idwe luka Simeon, kwape ajaatar ikekiakec: ajai airumetekec kidin kairumet naka idwe luka Yuda,
Apotu kesi kirumata Beer-seba, arai Seba, ka Molada;
ka Kasar-sual, ka Bala, ka Esem;
ka Elitolad, ka Betul, ka Koruma;
ka Sikilag, ka Ber-marakabot, ka Kasar-susa;
ka Bet-lebaot, ka Saruken; ireria itomon ka luuni ka ireriakec ludidik;
Ain, ka Rimon, ka Eter, ka Asan; ireria iwonon ka ireriakec ludidik:
ka ireria ludidik kere lualukunito ireria nul kiton Baalat-beer, Rama loka ari naka Eŋalakimak. Ŋin ŋes airumet naka ateker naka idwe luka Simeon kwape ajaatar ikekiakec.
Ajai airumet naka idwe luka Simeon toma owai loka idwe luka Yuda: naarai alalakinit noi idwe luka Yuda akorakinetekec: kanuka nun ŋes akorakinere idwe luka Simeon airumet kokidin airumetekec.
Kobeik eroet lokiwuniet idwe luka Sebulun kwape ajaatar ikekiakec: ajai eikor loka airumetekee kiton Sarid:
Kitor eikorukec ari nakoto, kiton Marala, kodol Dabeset; kodol da aguurut naejai kinaren ka Yokoneam;
Kokudo koSarid ari nakokide mama eniunia akoloŋ kiton oikor loka Kisilot-tabor; kobe Daberat, kitor Yapia;
Kobe kanen kiton Gat-keper, kiton Et-kasin; kitor Rimon loedolit Nea;
Kokudo eikor airimor ŋes kari naka eŋalakimak kiton Kanaton: kosan aditot naka Ipita-el;
ka Katat, ka Nakalal, ka Simuron, ka Idala, ka Bet-lekem: ireria itomon ka luarei ka ireriakec ludidik.
Ŋin ŋes airumet naka idwe luka Sebulun kwape ajaatar ikekiakec, ireria nul lukapolok ka ireriakec ludidik.
Kobeik eroet lokiwononet Isakar, kes idwe luka Isakar kwape ajaatar ikekiakec.
Ajai eikorukec kiton Yesereel, ka Kesulot, ka Sunem;
ka Kaparaim, ka Sion, ka Anakarat;
ka Rabit, ka Kision, ka Ebes;
ka Remet, ka En-ganim, ka En-kada, ka Bet-pases;
Kodol eikor Tabor, ka Sakasuma, ka Bet-semes; kosan eikorukec Yorodan: ireria itomon ka lukanykape ka ireriakec ludidik.
Ŋin ŋes airumet naka ateker naka idwe luka Isakar kwape ajaatar ikekiakec, ireria lukapolok ka ireriakec ludidik,
Kobeik eroet lokikanyet ateker naka idwe luka Aser, kwape ajaatar ikekiakec.
Eikorukec ŋes Kelakat, ka Kali, ka Beten, ka Akisap;
ka Alamelek, ka Amad, ka Misal; kodol Karamel kari nakoto, kiton Sikor-libunat da;
Kokudo neeniunia akoloŋ kiton Bet-dagon, kodol Sebulun, ka aditot naka Ipita-el kari naka agolitomei kiton Bet-emek, ka Neiel; kitor Kabul kakan nakokediany,
ka Eburon, ka Rekob, ka Kamon, ka Kana, kiton Sidon lokapolon;
Kokudo eikor kiton Rama, ka ere loebwaitai loka Turo; kokudo eikor kiton Kosa; kosan aŋolol kakwap naka Akisib:
Uma da, ka Apek, ka Rekob: ireria akaisaarei ka luarei ka ireriakec ludidik.
Ŋin ŋes airumet naka ateker naka idwe luka Aser kwape ajaatar ikekiakec, ireria nul lukapolok ka ireriakec ludidik.
Kobeik eroet lokikanyetekape idwe luka Naputali, kes idwe luka Naputali kwape ajaatar ikekiakec.
Ageunit eikorukec koKelep, ageun kolua loajai Saananim, ka Adami-nekeb, ka Yabuneel, kiton Lakum: kosan Yorodan:
Kokudo eikor ari nakoto kiton Asinot-tabor, kobe kanen kiton Kukok; kodolok Sebulun kari naka eŋalakimak, kodolok Aser kari nakoto, ka Yuda da koYorodan kaneeŋiunia akoloŋ,
Ireria luabwaitai kes Sidim, ka Ser, ka Kamat, ka Rakat ka Kineret;
ka Adama, ka Rama, ka Kasor;
ka Kedes, ka Ederei, ka En-kasor;
ka Iron, ka Migidal-el, ka Korem, ka Bet-anat, ka Bet-semes; ireria itomon ka lukanykaonon ka ireriakec ludidik.
Ŋin ŋes airumet naka ateker naka idwe luka Naputali kwape ajaatar ikekiakee, ireria lukapolok ka ireriakec ludidik,
Kobeik eroet lokikanyetekaarei ateker naka idwe luka Dan kwape ajaatar ikekiakec.
Eikor loka airumetekec ŋes Sora, ka Esitaol, ka Ir-semes;
ka Saalabin, ka Aiyalon, ka Itila;
ka Elon, ka Timuna, ka Ekuron;
ka Eliteke, ka Gibeton, ka Baalat;
ka Yekud, ka Bene-berak, ka Gatrimon;
ka Me-yarikon, ka Rakon, kiteos eikor kaYopa.

Kisukunyikis idwe luka Dan eikorukee: naarai apotu idwe luka Dan kolomasi aitiji Lesem, koyanaasi ŋes, kodanyata luken kakwanis naka ekileŋ, kirumata, kiboikinos toma, komaikis Lesem Dan, ekiror loka papakec.
Ŋin ŋes airumet naka ateker naka idwe luka Dan kwape ajaatar ikekiakee, ireria ŋullukapolok ka ireriakec ludidik.
Kitananata kwaŋin akorokor airumeta nuka akwap kwape ajaatar iikorunoke; koinakis idwe luka Isirael Yosua okoku loka Nun airumet kamakee:
Apotu koinakis ŋes ere loelipit, ŋes Timunat-sera kotoma akwap nakiukon naka Epuraim, kwape ajaar aicorakinet naka EJAKAIT: abu koduk ere, kiboikin roma.

Ŋun kes airumeta nuapotu Eleasar esasedoti, ka Yosua okoku loka Nun, ka ikapolok luka ikalia luka lukapapaa luka atekerin nuka idwe luka Isirael kokorokorata kes airum kailamilam eroet koSilo kakonyen nuka EJAKAIT kokek loka ewema loka airiamunun. Kitananata kwaŋin akorokor akwap.
